column3: The five elements together: five small marks in a row, a square, a drop, a flame, three wind curls and an open ring
The eight direction guardians: a row of eight small arches of equal height standing under one long arc
The sixteen zones: a circle cut into sixteen equal sectors, one sector shaded, with a short north tick
The Vastu mandala: a square grid of nine by nine small cells with the nine centre cells marked and a small circle in the middle
Vastu Purusha: a thin outline of a figure lying face down along the diagonal of a square, head at the upper right corner
Guides that disagree: two short signposts on one post, pointing in different directions
Finding north: a plain round needle compass seen from above, one long needle and a small N mark at the top of its ring
The shadow method: an upright stick with two shadow-tip marks on a circle and a straight line joining them
